lesson_quiz.question: Theo noi dung bai hoc, vi du nao sau day minh hoa cho su han che cua mot chuong trinh tinh co lap?
options: He thong tu dong cap nhat thoi tiet theo thoi gian thuc.
Thiet bi quet ma vach o sieu thi khong the nhan dien san pham moi va in ra hoa don.
Ung dung gui tin nhan tu dong khi co nguoi click chuot.
He thong dat ve may bay truc tuyen.
lesson_quiz.explanation: He thong quet ma vach neu bi co lap se khong the doc ma vach thuc te tu nhan vien quet cung nhu khong in duoc hoa don cho khach hang nhu bai hoc da neu.

lesson_quiz.question: Loi ich hang dau cua luong du lieu hai chieu doi voi kien truc code la gi?
options: Giup chuong trinh tang toc do tinh toan gap hang tram lan.
Bao mat ma nguon tuyet doi khoi cac cuoc tan cong vao o cung.
Xu ly linh dong hang trieu kich ban du lieu khac nhau chi voi mot cau truc ma nguon duy nhat.
Loai bo hoan toan khoi ma cua he dieu hanh.
lesson_quiz.explanation: Nho tuong tac hai chieu linh hoat giup nhan dau vao phu hop, lap trinh vien chi can xay dung mot cau truc ma duy nhat ma van xu ly duoc rat nhieu truong hop du lieu khac nhau.

lesson_quiz.question: He thong nhap xuat tieu chuan cua Python duoc Guido van Rossum tich hop lan dau vao nam nao?
lesson_quiz.explanation: Theo bai doc, nha sang lap Python - Guido van Rossum da tich hop he thong nhap xuat ngay tu phien ban dau tien vao nam 1991.

lesson_quiz.question: Thiet ke nhap xuat tieu chuan cua Python huong toi viec khac phuc nhuoc diem nao cua C/C++?
options: Toc do thuc thi cham cua cac ham nhap xuat ma C/C++ su dung.
Su thieu an toan bo nho cua cac bien so toan cuc.
Cac ma nguon rum ra (boilerplate code) phuc tap khi thuc hien giao tiep I/O.
Su phu thuoc vao trinh bien dich doc quyen.
lesson_quiz.explanation: He thong I/O tinh gon cua Python huong den viec toi gian hoa cac boilerplate code (ma nguon rum ra) phuc tap pho bien tren C/C++.

practical_lab.title: Khao Sat Su Lam Viec Cua Chuong Trinh Co Lap Va Chuong Trinh Tuong Tac
objectives: Nhan biet su khac biet truc quan giua mot chuong trinh su dung bien gan cung so voi chuong trinh dung luong tuong tac hai chieu.
Thuc hanh nhap lieu thuc te va quan sat cach Python Engine tiep nhan, xu ly va phan hoi ket qua qua console.

description.inputs: Dự án/môi trường phát triển python/core hiện tại và tài nguyên khóa học.
steps: Viet mot doan ma nguon Python gan san bien dang code chay thuc te de xem tinh trang co lap: san_pham = 'Tao My' va in ra gia tri nay.
Dung ham tuong tac de thay the bien gan cung bang cach gan san_pham = input() de dong thoi cho phep nguoi dung nhap truc tiep tu ban phim.
Chay chuong trinh voi cac gia tri dau vao khac nhau va ghi nhan thong ke so luong gia tri xuat ra console tuong ung.

checklist: Chung minh duoc su thay doi dau ra tuong ung khi thay doi du lieu dau vao.
Chuong trinh khong bi treo va ket thuc thanh cong sau khi xuat ket qua.
